languageSecurityMappings.mutation: Async setCharts explicit bytes and context; CLI charts set through the same domain editor. One-based slide selection or fingerprinted token; no live model alias is introduced.
languageSecurityMappings.titleText: Empty string creates empty content; existing rich text retains body/list settings and replaces paragraph content using the package whole-frame assignment semantics. Individual run formatting is replaced.
languageSecurityMappings.model: Neutral chart_title, has_text_frame, text_frame and format remain public obligations. Getters, creation side effects, inheritance and live ownership are not emulated by snapshots.
languageSecurityMappings.authority: No implicit host I/O, native runtime, external workbook fetching, reflection or network.
